correctness.rationale: Two-phase strong Markov splitting at first endpoint, reset-generating function F_x(s), and renewal H_x^r=(1-F_x)/(r F_0) give the exact mean. Chebyshev coefficient recurrence has positive coefficients; discounted survival-tail representation is convex, strictly so L>=2, while L=1 is affine M_1(u)=5+3u. Exact boundary derivative L^2(25-7L^2)/6 is negative L>=2. Uniform arcosh expansion at r=alpha/L^2 gives f(alpha) and h(alpha), and coercivity plus f strict convexity give alpha_* and optimized order-one term. Nine independent exact-rational finite-state mean calculations for L<=3 and rates 0,1/5,1/2 matched; extrapolation not used as proof.

value.rationale: Completing coverage of two endpoints is a natural renewal-search objective rather than one-target hitting. The exact five-vertex positive-reset threshold, all-rate uniqueness, and O(1) lattice correction to the previously known continuum optimizer are concrete reusable discrete search results.

final_claim: On centered reflected path [-L,L] with graph-neighbor steps and geometric reset probability r that costs one step, mean complete-coverage time is (3Z-1-2/Z)/r with Z=T_L(1/(1-r)); reset odds convex, unique positive optimizer iff L>=2, and exact order-one diffusive lattice correction.
limitations: Uniformly reflected odd path, central geometric resets consuming a step, non-reset boundary transition deterministic inward; not arbitrary resetting law nor arbitrary network.
Continuum f(alpha) is previous literature; novelty restricted to the exact lattice formula, convexity threshold, and lattice optimum correction.
